0.original:
Wh-What a monster...

He killed his own ally...

1.original: Go back to the Kame House now, you two!

3.original: Gohan! You heard him! Let's get outta here!

5.original:
That Saiyan is beyond us!

There's nothing we could do if we stayed!

We'd only be in Goku's way!

6.original: Sorry. He's much stronger than I thought.

8.original: Oh yeah, Goku! Could you take the battle to somewhere a little farther away from here?

9.original: We don't want everyone's bodies to get blown to pieces before we wish them back...

10.original:
What do you mean wish them back?

Piccolo and Kami are dead. The Dragon Balls are gone forever.

There's no way to bring them back now.

12.original:
I'll fill you in on the details later!

If you beat him, that is...

13.original:
Yeah, if I beat him...

I gotta beat him. No matter what it takes.

15.original:
What are you waiting around for? Lost your will to fight?

Did you get scared and decide to start planning your escape?

16.original:
Well, time to try my luck.

Leave it to me.

17.original:
Goku... Sorry to always have to put our fate into your hands...

Just don't die on us. You're my best friend!

19.original: Gohan. If I make it back alive, let's go fishing again sometime, OK?

20.original: Looks like you've realized it's pointless to run.

22.original: Whatever you want. It won't change anything.

23.original:
What's wrong, Kakarot?! You can do better than that!

This isn't the Kakarot who defeated Nappa!

Come on! Show me what you got!

24.original:
He wasn't kidding...

He hasn't even started seriously fighting yet...

And I'm already outclassed in both speed and skill.

26.original: (But still... This is making me so excited! I don't care how dangerous it is!)

27.original:
You're smiling... Have you given up the fight?!

Or do you still have it in you to fight even harder?!

28.original:
I guess that's all you've got...

Well, here's a little present for you before you die...

The full, overwhelming power of an elite Saiyan warrior!

30.original:
Heh heh heh...

I'll wipe that grin off your face!

32.original:
N-no!

His... his power level's greater than mine!

34.original:
I... I can't believe this is happening!

I am an elite warrior! There's no way a lower-class Saiyan could defeat me!

35.original: (I am the greatest fighter in the universe!)

36.original:
Heh heh... You should be honored.

Not many low-class warriors like you get to lock horns with a super elite...

37.original:
Saiyans are tested at birth on their potential as warriors.

Those whose tests reveals a low value like you will be sent to planets of weak resistance.

In other words, you're the bottom of the barrel.

38.original:
Thanks to that I was sent to Earth. I should be grateful.

But who knows, with enough hard work, even a low-class warrior might surpass a super elite.

39.original:
Heh. That's a laugh.

Now how about I show you the wall that no amount of hard work could ever overcome?

41.original: ...Mr. Popo... I'm sorry I wasn't able to save Piccolo...

42.original:
I know...

But it is fate that Kami is gone. Kami knew this the best.

43.original: ...But good had been born in Piccolo's heart. Kami was pleased.

45.original: Of course we're sad! Kami's gone... Aren't you sad, Mr. Popo?

46.original:
I've learned a lot from Kami here.

Kami wouldn't want me to mope around.

You should try looking ahead too.

48.original: Anyway, I called you all here for a reason!

49.original: Oh yeah! What is it, Mr. Popo?

50.original:
The Dragon Balls disappeared with Kami.

But I always watched him when he made them.

That's why I tried to copy him and make my own...

But they aren't as good as Kami's.

The wish that can be granted is limited...

51.original: So you mean, there are new Dragon Balls?!

52.original:
They're different from the ones that Kami made.

Truthfully, they aren't real Dragon Balls...

But they could be useful...

54.original:
The dragon radar should be able to show you their location.

Go and find them together! They should be of some use...

55.original:
All right! Let's get going!

Thanks, Mr. Popo!

57.original: Baba told me she wanted to see you!

59.original:
I don't know...

Go and see her if you want to find out.

60.original:
Nooooo!! How...?!

How could Kakarot's power be stronger than mine... I'm a Super Elite...

61.original:
That low-class weakling!!!

I'm number one! I'm the strongest Saiyan there is!!!

62.original:
The only one thing left is to change into a Great Ape and crush him!

Heh heh heh... He will soon know the horror of my transformation!

63.original:
That rat!

We came here on the day of a full moon in order to make fast work of this planet...

...But I never thought I'd have to transform to beat him!

What an embarrassment...!

64.original:
? That's strange...

The moon should be out by now...

65.original:
Of course! I can't believe it.

He's done it this time!

That Kakarot actually destroyed the moon!

66.original:
......

My ki will drop slightly but there's no choice now...

67.original: I can't wait to see the look on his face! Wah hah hah hah hah!

68.original: (Looks like I'll have to use the Spirit Bomb to win... I hope I have time to concentrate...!)

69.original: You probably think you're pretty smart for destroying the moon, but don't think you've won just yet!

70.original: The moon?! What are you talking about?

71.original:
Heh heh heh... Don't play dumb with me.

Do you wanna know why we transform when we see a full moon?

73.original:
Everyone knows that moon light is just reflected sun light...

But only when that sun light hits the moon does it create Blutz waves.

During a full moon, those Blutz waves exceed 17 million zenos.

74.original:
Absorbing Blutz waves through the eyes at over 17 million zenos causes the tail to react and the transformation to begin!

There are many moons of different sizes in the universe, yet no matter what the size, only a full moon reaches the required 17 million.

75.original:
However... Certain Saiyans have the power to create their own small full moons that emit the required 17 million zenos!

By combining the oxygen in the air with this power ball!

76.original:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Kakarot! At last, it's time for you to die!

You'll soon regret ever trying to go up against a Super Elite!

Hah hah hah...

77.original:
The second he created that weird light his ki dropped!

Why would he use up so much energy? I don't understand!

79.original: What is this? What's did he do?!

80.original: You'll be sorry you lost your tail, Kakarot!

81.original: The Kame House is just a little further. Hang in there, Gohan!

82.original: What the?! I sense a huge Ki... And it's getting bigger...

83.original: It's not my dad this time... is it?

84.original:
No... This bad feeling I get must be that Saiyan!

It's so powerful... What's going on?!

87.original: Huh?! You mean back to where Goku is?!

88.original:
He's in trouble...

I can feel it... If I don't go back he's gonna die!

89.original: But that guy's so strong, there's nothing we could do...

90.original: I... I know... But I have to go.

92.original: Hah hah hah! How do you like that, huh?! You can't even run from me!

93.original: Y-you're so huge... How can you be so fast?!

94.original:
Heh... you're pretty obstinate.

But you're just about at your limit. I can tell.

96.original:
However, it's time to end this, Kakarot!

Even if you could be resurrected, your planet will be history by then!

98.original:
Gwah hah hah hah! Now what do you plan on doing, Kakarot??

You're finished!

101.original:
I'll let you in on a little something...

When a Saiyan becomes a Great Ape, his power is increased ten fold!

102.original:
I see... Now I understand...

I can't believe it... It was me who killed Grandpa Gohan...

The monster that appeared and destroyed the fighting venue... It was me...!

103.original:
(Forgive me, Grandpa Gohan... This guy is way too strong.

I might have to use up all my ki to beat him...

If I die, I promise to visit you, Grandpa, and apologize...)

105.original:
Wh-What's going on here...?!

Where did that monster come from?! It's... totally not of this world...

That armor it's wearing... Is it that Saiyan?!

106.original: How about I give you a taste of the Earth's Spirit Bomb!

107.original:
Just great... He's got me... totally beat...

I didn't think he'd be this strong...

It was exciting fighting someone so strong...

But... I hate... having to... die again...

110.original: Heh heh... That was... My last bit of strength...

111.original:
N-Now I don't have enough strength to even... pick my nose...

Go ahead and finish me off...

112.original:
Ugh... gh...! Why you little...! Kakarot!

Look what you've done to my face! I'm going to crush you like an egg!

114.original:
Eeeek! Th-This is bad...

There's... nothing I can do! He's as good as dead...

It's not that I won't help, it's just...

There's nothing I could do... Don't hate me, Goku...

120.original: Hey! Who do you think that monster is?! It's the Saiyan!

121.original: I know! If someone can cut off his tail, he'll return to normal!

123.original:
Yeah, now listen!

You and Gohan get in front of him and get his attention!

Then I'll pop in from behind and cut his tail!

125.original:
Get his attention? You gotta be kidding me!

You guys are crazy! Even if he goes back to normal he's still incredibly strong!

126.original:
(N-no! This guy's like nothing I've seen before!)

(Even as a monster, he's still so calm... He's not letting his guard down for a moment!)

127.original:
Haaaah hah hah hah!

It was a mistake for you to challenge me from the very beginning!

128.original: Oh, no! I've got to do something... anything!

131.original:
(Goku's Ki is almost all gone!

This isn't good! He's on the verge of dying...!)

134.original:
What a surprise. Kakarot's son, eh?

So, you've come to see your father's last moments have you?

135.original:
N-No...!

There was one more of them...! My... My tail...!

137.original: (That's it for me! You're all on your own now!)

138.original:
Gohan...

My body's all messed up... I... I can't move anymore...

Y-you have to fight for me...

His... his power has to be pretty low by now...

139.original:
I... I can't, Daddy. H-he's too strong...

I... I could never beat him.

140.original:
It... doesn't matter. Just keep him... from attacking...

You've got more power than that... far more power...

Y-you can have Krillin... deliver the final blow...

142.original:
D-don't be stupid!

You want all of their deaths to be for nothing?!

D-didn't Piccolo... teach you anything...?

144.original: You've certainly given me a tough time for such trash...

150.original: You better not try to rile the great Vegeta!

151.original: You did it, Yajirobe! He returned to normal...!

152.original: You humans must really have a death wish...

154.original: If so, then let me grant it for you! Filthy pests!

155.original:
Arrgh!

I can't even hit him, he moves around so much!

156.original: Do not aim the Spirit Bomb with your eyes. Feel his evil energy with your mind!

158.original:
I am King Kai, the one who taught Goku the ways of the Spirit Bomb.

Your next move will finish this entire fight.

The Spirit Bomb you wield contains the hopes of every living thing on this planet!

161.original: F-feel the evil energy with my mind...

163.original: (Come on! Feel it! Feel his evil aura!)

164.original:
Haaahh hah hah hah! You watching this, Kakarot?!

Your pathetic son's life ends here!

167.original:
Deflect it, Gohan! It's on our side!

You've got a pure heart, Gohan! You can bounce it off your body!

168.original:
G-Goku... We can't do it...

He's just... too strong...

Why didn't you tell Gohan to run...

169.original:
This is my chance... to give you something Krillin...

It's all the energy I gathered... from the Earth into a Spirit Bomb...!

170.original:
...Huh? What'd you say?!

What'd you say you were gonna give me?!

171.original:
A... Spirit Bomb... It holds a bit of the energy from... all over the Earth...

About half of it escaped, but... It might work against him in the shape he's in...

176.original: So I just need to take your hand, right...?

180.original: Don't worry about it... Just don't let go...!

181.original: I'll pass it on to you... So take it...

183.original:
You gotta hit him with it, Krillin...

I... can't make another one... Make sure... you hit him... I'm counting on you!

184.original: O-OK! I'll try... Leave it to me!

186.original: Hah hah... I thought it was all over more than once...

187.original: Heh heh... You're both pretty beat up...

191.original: Don't worry, it's just his dead body.

192.original: He sure was horrible... But we might as well dig a hole for his grave...

194.original:
You've really done it this time...

I thought I was about to die from that last attack.

195.original:
That... That's crazy...!

He took the Spirit Bomb straight on...

196.original: I've taken quite a bit of damage... But I at least have enough power left to finish wiping the floor with you humans.

197.original: After I kill all of you I'll wait for my body to heal... And then I'll destroy this planet!

199.original:
You humans...

You've made me use up most of my power...

Even with the numbers against me, having this done to me by trash like you has hurt my pride...

200.original: Now do me a favor and die!

203.original:
Damn it! That was a weak blast...

They've all still managed to live through it...

204.original:
...!

I'm more... damaged than I thought... I better finish them off soon and rest...

206.original:
(His tail...!

That's right... Goku grew his tail back once before too...!)

207.original: If he changes, then I'm in trouble...!

211.original: Hah... hah... Hah hah! Hah hah hah haaaah!

212.original:
Haaaah hah hah hah! I did it! Woohoo! Take that!

Who's the man huh? Me, that's who! Heh heh heh!

213.original:
How's it feel?!

You should have known you could never win against me!

215.original:
Oh, sorry! Did that hurt?!

I was just kidding around... Did that cut you?

Oh yeah!

I uh... I really respect you, you know! Could we be friends?

216.original: *Pant... pant...* I won't let you get away with that!

218.original: Gohan!! Look at the sky! Look at the glowing ball in the sky!

224.original:
Noooo! You brat...! I won't let you transform!

I've got to kill him now...!

226.original: A Great Ape...? This is gonna be either a hit or a miss...!

227.original:
That's right! His tail! I forgot the most important thing...!

If I can just cut off his tail...!!

230.original: When Goku went Great Ape, he lost all reason! I wonder if Gohan is the same...?!

232.original:
Eeek! He's the same!

Now I get it...

It's not that they lose reason...

They probably just return to being violent Saiyans...!

233.original: Gohan... The Saiyan...! Go after the Saiyan!

236.original:
Yeah, that's the ticket! Looks like a part of Gohan is still inside...!

He is half human, I guess!

237.original:
This can't be happening!

If I hadn't taken so much damage I could easily handle one or two of these monsters!

That moon I made won't burn out for another hour...

Cutting off his tail is my only option!

241.original: What's with this guy... He just won't die...

244.original: A little more... Just a little more to the left.

246.original: There they are! That light. Everyone's below that light.

247.original:
Are you sure?! Is my Gohan really alive!

He's really alive right?!

248.original: I told you they probably would be!

249.original: That's why I said we shouldn't have brought her along...

250.original: What do you mean probably?! Probably isn't good enough!

252.original:
I can only feel the Ki of four of them... No, five...

Their Ki is very weak... What's going on?

253.original:
Can't tell... I was only able to watch part of the battle...

But the Saiyan also seems to be on the verge of death...

260.original: We've come this far... Now to finish it...

261.original:
Whew... They've all done well. I was worried there...

I know I shouldn't play favorites, but...

That Saiyan stroke fear into the whole universe. This was for the best...

262.original:
......

Although, it doesn't mean that all evil in the universe has been silenced...

...Not all of it...

264.original: This is for all my friends... Everyone you killed!

269.original:
That voice I hear...

Is that you, Goku...?

270.original:
(Yeah, it's me... I can't raise my voice very well...

Krillin, do me a favor... Let him go...

Please... It's my last request...)

271.original:
Are you serious, Goku?! He killed all of our friends!

He even tried to kill everyone on Earth!

If we let him go, he'll recover and be back for sure!

273.original:
Goku...

If you think that he could change for the better like Piccolo did...

You're wrong!

This guy's different!

He's got no feelings whatsoever!

You should know that Goku!

274.original:
(I know... I know he's really strong too...

I don't know how to explain it, but...

Looking at him about to die... made me think...)

275.original: (It'd be such a waste to kill him...)

277.original:
(I trained with King Kai himself... I was supposed to have reached the peak of my ability... Heh heh...

But Vegeta was still... Far stronger than me...

To tell you the truth, I didn't have a chance...)

278.original:
(But... Deep down... It made me excited...

Just like with Piccolo... I guess it's because I'm a Saiyan too...

Like a bad habit...)

279.original:
(I'm gonna train harder and beat him the next time, no matter what!

I know it's a bad decision but... Please, Krillin!

Give me the chance to fight him alone!)

280.original:
All right, Goku... You deserve to get your way.

The Earth is still here because of you...

But listen, Goku!

Next time you better take him out with ease!

282.original:
There won't be any... miracles the next time... Remember that...

Heh heh... You can look forward to it...

285.original: That idiot... Why didn't he finish him off?!

287.original:
Heh heh... Don't worry about it...

Although I feel like I shamed everyone who died...

...But there might be a way to bring them back...

291.original:
Gohan! My poor little Gohan! It's gonna be all right!

Hang in there! Mommy's here! Oh you poor thing!

292.original: Gohan's just fine... It's Goku I think you should be worrying about...

293.original:
Poor little thing, being dragged into this mess!

I won't ever let him out of my sight again!

294.original: ...Isn't that a little much? Poor Goku ...

297.original: Sorry everyone... I let the Saiyan get away...

298.original: You did good for coming even this far...

300.original:
That guy was more than just strong... Bulma...

Everyone was killed except for us... Even Yamcha...

301.original:
I had that feeling. But I'm OK!

We can just bring him back with the Dragon Balls in a year!

303.original:
Piccolo was killed. That means Kami is gone too.

Without him, the Dragon Balls are gone.

304.original:
What are you saying?! Don't lie to me!

Four of you survived, right?

Piccolo's the fourth one, isn't he?!

306.original: No... It can't be... So, Yamcha will never come back?!

310.original: Oh my... I too had thought Piccolo had survived...

311.original:
Wh-What?! You were hoping that I was Piccolo?!

If it wasn't for me, these guys wouldn't be alive right now!

I'm not gonna take this! This isn't what I deserve!

312.original:
All right, we got it!

Now, we gotta get these guys to a hospital! I've got no more Senzu beans.

315.original: Uh... Yeah. They're a little further over there...

316.original:
Don't cry, Bulma...

I have an idea...

There might not be any chance of it working and...It might not actually be possible, but...

317.original:
...Now don't get your hopes up...

I'm just saying that...

There might be a way to bring everyone back...

318.original: It may be a little far fetched, but...

319.original:
Krillin... You were saying something about that earlier...

What is it...? Tell us...

320.original:
Wait! I'll tell you all later!

Master Roshi, this is where the bodies are! We need to get them inside...!

321.original:
My oh my... This is quite brutal...

Now all we need to find is Chiaotzu's body... but...?!

322.original: ...You won't find it. He... blew himself to pieces...

323.original:
I really wish we could bring everyone back...

Their sacrifice was too much...

324.original: I feel angry about my helplessness, Korin...

325.original: It's OK, I'll drive. I've settled down now...

331.original:
Oh my poor baby!

You've been through so much! But everything's going to be just fine!

335.original:
He ran... He got away...

But we gave him a good beating!

He'll probably never come back!

337.original:
Behind you, Gohan...

Thanks to you guys, I was able to stay alive!

339.original: Krillin, would you tell us what you were talking about before?

340.original:
Oh yeah! That's right.

The Saiyans seem to have heard about the Dragon Balls through Raditz when Goku fought him.

They found out their wish could be granted.

That's why they came to Earth, so they could get the Dragon Balls.

342.original:
Yeah.

But when they looked at Piccolo, they said something strange.

They called him a Namek. It seems like Piccolo and Kami were once aliens.

343.original:
Then he mentioned how it must be true

about there being mysterious balls that granted wishes on the planet Namek.

He said, even if they couldn't get them on Earth, they could just go to Namek.

344.original:
That's right! I heard it too!

They said Nameks have the ability to make them!

345.original:
If... And this is a big if... If there were some way we could get to planet Namek...

We might be able to find Dragon Balls.

346.original:
Very interesting...

Then, we could wish back everyone who was killed!

348.original:
Yeah! Piccolo and Kami too!

That would make the Dragon Balls here reappear!

349.original:
Thus, Goku and friends found a way to bring back their deceased companions.

Where could this planet Namek be?

Could they really find new Dragon Balls?

And what could be waiting for them there?

Let us save the rest of the story for another time...
